candidate_rule: A dictionary node is exact-candidate only when its key set contains every P3Y required_row_field; partial overlap is diagnostic only.

branch_rule.candidate_found: Validate exact rows and stock grouping against P3Y before any pixel or fit work.
branch_rule.no_candidate: Record a controlled-halation data gap and continue another ready physical R&D leaf without weakening P3Y.

forbidden: read image, PDF, archive or media payloads
infer missing anchor, alignment, roll, process or scanner facts
treat partial key overlap as admission
relax P3Y requirements after the audit
claim_ceiling: Bounded local metadata inventory against P3Y only; no pixel evidence, acquisition validity, film mechanism or product claim.
